collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record && cp {RUN}/route/case.json {RUN}/route/config.mk {RUN}/route/constraint.sdc {RUN}/route/signoff.sdc {RUN}/route/wf_sta.json {RUN}/route/wf_drv.json {RUN}/route/check.json {RUN}/route/wfc_source_corner_sta.json {RUN}/route/wf_drv_TT.json {RUN}/record/ && B=$(ls -d {RUN}/route/results/asap7/*/base | tail -1) && cp "$B/6_final.odb" "$B/6_final.def" "$B/6_final.v" "$B/6_final.sdc" "$B/6_final.spef" {RUN}/record/ && cp {CL}/calib.json {RUN}/record/calib.json
